knowledge.name: Bundled synthetic omnichannel evidence
knowledge.detail: Fixed channel, journey, campaign, conversion, cost, revenue, ROI, and bounce-rate records support deterministic demonstrations.

knowledge.name: Operating rules and safety anchors
knowledge.detail: Uploaded rules define persona routing, required evidence headings, aggregate-only analysis, consent controls, and prohibited actions.

intelligence_processing.name: Aggregate channel performance analysis
intelligence_processing.detail: Compares synthetic sessions, conversions, revenue, cost, ROAS, bounce rate, and revenue share without identity stitching.

intelligence_processing.name: Privacy-safe journey friction analysis
intelligence_processing.detail: Reviews four aggregate journey archetypes for touchpoint order, duration, conversion, handoff friction, and service continuity.

intelligence_processing.name: Consent-aware engagement optimization
intelligence_processing.detail: Ranks aggregate channel efficiency and drafts controlled experiments with optional preferences, consent, and frequency caps.

intelligence_processing.name: Synthetic campaign attribution review
intelligence_processing.detail: Summarizes campaign channel, conversions, revenue, cost, ROI, and limitations while distinguishing attribution from causality.

intelligence_processing.name: Persona-aligned recommendation preparation
intelligence_processing.detail: Frames evidence and review-only options for customer-experience, digital-engagement, and contact-center leaders.

clients_user_interface.name: Copilot Studio conversational experience
clients_user_interface.detail: Provides natural-language access through a validated Draft agent with four skills, two knowledge files, and no configured write tools.

clients_user_interface.name: Microsoft 365 Copilot review surface
clients_user_interface.detail: Supports governed conversational review of aggregate channel, journey, optimization, and attribution findings without taking action.

clients_user_interface.name: Portable Brainstem chat experience
clients_user_interface.detail: Runs the single-file RAPP agent through local Brainstem chat and UI endpoints with synthetic-only deterministic routing.

management_reporting.name: Channel performance scorecard
management_reporting.detail: Reports synthetic sessions, conversions, CVR, revenue, cost, ROAS, bounce rate, and channel revenue share for review.

management_reporting.name: Journey friction and continuity review
management_reporting.detail: Presents archetype sequences, duration, touchpoint counts, conversion rates, friction observations, and draft next steps.

management_reporting.name: Campaign efficiency and attribution brief
management_reporting.detail: Reports fixed campaign conversions, revenue, cost, ROI, and click metrics with explicit non-causal interpretation limits.

tools.name: Portable RAPP Omnichannel Engagement Agent
tools.detail: Single-file OmnichannelEngagementAgent implements four read-only operations with bundled synthetic data and no credentials.

tools.name: Microsoft Copilot Studio
tools.detail: Hosts the four-skill conversational package; validated artifacts remain Draft and require explicit human approval before publish.

tools.name: Microsoft 365 Copilot
tools.detail: Provides a cited collaboration surface for governed review of aggregate insights and draft recommendations without side effects.

tools.name: Dynamics 365
tools.detail: Cited production seam for approved aggregate CRM and commerce context; it is not connected in the synthetic package.

tools.name: Outlook
tools.detail: Cited review surface for engagement context; the package never sends, schedules, or drafts customer outreach automatically.

tools.name: Approved aggregate CRM and commerce analytics
tools.detail: Human-reviewed read-only integration may replace synthetic evidence after authorization; no live connection is configured.

tools.name: Approved contact-center analytics
tools.detail: Governed aggregate feed may support handoff analysis after review; the current implementation uses fixed synthetic archetypes.

supporting_features.name: Aggregate-only privacy boundary
supporting_features.detail: Prohibits identity stitching, individual journey reconstruction, sensitive profiling, and invention of missing customer facts.

supporting_features.name: Four deterministic operations
supporting_features.detail: Routes channel performance, journey analysis, engagement optimization, and campaign attribution requests from persona language.

supporting_features.name: Consent and frequency controls
supporting_features.detail: Requires optimization options to preserve consent, optional preferences, frequency caps, stated assumptions, and review gates.

supporting_features.name: Human review and no-side-effect seam
supporting_features.detail: Keeps outputs advisory and forbids outreach, messages, offers, rewards, record changes, purchases, or silent authorization.

supporting_features.name: Locked case and isolation validation
supporting_features.detail: Maintains one persona-language case per operation and records four passing captures with only the expected RAPP tool loaded.

supporting_features.name: Draft and publication control
supporting_features.detail: Keeps Copilot Studio artifacts unpublished, validates four preview cases, and makes publication a separate approved step.

supporting_features.name: Portable package and evidence trail
supporting_features.detail: Includes source RAPP, deployment recipe, skills, knowledge, export bundle, hashes, screenshots, and review evidence.
